Washoe County Planning Commission                                                                      October 6, 2026

Appeal Procedure
Most decisions rendered by the Planning Commission are appealable to the Board of County Commissioners. If you
disagree with the decision of the Planning Commission and you qualify as an aggrieved person/party, you may
appeal the decision in writing within ten (10) calendar days from the date that the decision being appealed is
reduced to writing, filed with the Secretary of the Planning Commission, and mailed to the original applicant in the
proceeding being appealed, in accordance with Washoe County Code. Please call the Planning staff immediately at
(775) 328-6100 for information on the appeal procedure and application fee.
_
_
                                                           AGENDA

6:00 P.M.

5.     Public Comment [Non-action item]

       Comment heard under this item will be limited to three minutes per person and may pertain to matters
       both on and off the agenda. However, action may not be taken on any matter raised during this public
       comment period until the matter is specifically listed on an agenda as an action item. Comments are to be
       made to the Planning Commission as a whole.

      For hearing, discussion, and possible action to approve an amendment of conditions to add a condition

      electric generating facility in the playa area of the parcel. This application is submitted by NVSolarWRX
      on behalf of property owners Robert Simmons and Michel Luttrell. The subject property is located in
      the Honey Lake Valley, 2 miles north of Fish Springs Road and 3 miles east of the Nevada/California

Washoe County Planning Commission                                                                  October 6, 2026

      For hearing, discussion, and possible action to approve a common open space tentative subdivision
      map for a 34-lot common open space development, on two parcels (APNs 077-090-13 and 077-090-14)
      totaling 773.36 acres, with lots ranging in size from 2.50 acres to 2.82 acres. The project will include
      grading of 28,500 cubic yards of material. The application was submitted by Palomino Farms, LLC. The
      subject property is located at 0 Whiskey Springs Road and 0 Sage Flat Road (The proposal is being
      reviewed under Development Code Article 608, Tentative Subdivision Maps, and Article 408, Common
      Open Space. The property is situated within Commission District 5. The site is currently governed by
      the Suburban Residential land use designation and the Public/Semi-Public Facilities (PSP), Low Density
      Suburban (LDS), General Rural (GR), and General Commercial (GC) zoning districts, within the
      boundaries of the Warm Springs Planning Area.

      Attachments:    WTM25-001 - PALOMINO FARMS - Staff Report - TMP 12410
